activity: Initial quiet readiness; retain entry/before/after/terminal host observations. As in the accepted Cargo-parent protocol, background activity never selects or rejects instruction samples based on effect. No native elapsed claim.

authority.note: Excluded preparation follows the accepted current-runtime pair. Numbered work still requires exact new inputs/cohort and Root authority.

budget.setup_profiles: Exactly one excluded baseline and candidate parity profile per host, permanently outside eligibility and statistics.

child_environment: Keep the original live jobserver. Only differing CARGO_MAKEFLAGS descriptor values are omitted from comparison; raw ordered environment is retained. The validated loader removes its own instrumentation environment before native children.

decision_table.condition: A prerequisite, exact binary/context/output, trace, exit, completeness, integrity or restoration guard fails; any observation is missing
decision_table.decision: Cohort invalid/unqualified. Preserve every record; restore and park owned states. Keep incomplete/invalid effects unread. No replacement, extension, alternate host or retry of measured work.

decision_table.condition: Both complete raw/restoration gates pass, but either block has any tie/loss, sign p >= .01 or lower 99% reduction bound <= .0025
decision_table.decision: Valid negative. No extra samples, changed threshold or new pilot.

decision_table.condition: Both complete raw/restoration and metric gates pass and each block has 8/8 wins, p < .01 and lower 99% reduction bound > .0025
decision_table.decision: Qualifies the Cargo-parent Ir endpoint only after both independent blocks and raw replay. No whole-command wall claim or automatic publication.

endpoint_entry: Only dirty check. The independently accepted original D cohort and the separately tested formatted artifact are prerequisites; no new eligibility pilot.

host_capacity.reason: Two check-only banks per host; no test-build banks. Preserve trait’s earlier T-donor150GiB readiness refusal.

masking: Both complete 16-record raw/restoration gates, including actual cache witnesses, precede all 32 metric joins; these precede either unpooled host estimate. Excluded setup profiles stay outside statistics.
metric: Final Callgrind Ir for the complete Cargo parent, all parent threads, trace-children=no; compiler/linker/build-script/test children excluded.
metric_integrity: Both complete raw/restoration gates before decoding; all 32 final/self/stderr and raw/gzip joins, exact command/Ir format, and no brk segment overflow warning before either statistical comparison.
native: No native-wall supplement is part of this design.
preflight: Independently copied same-host, same-arm byte-authenticated warm banks; two native warm/fresh cycles, then one native dirty reference and one opaque Cargo-parent profile per arm per host. Fresh exact contexts, diagnostics, outputs and restoration; excluded counters remain unread.

producer.binary_pair: Unchanged authenticated original baseline and the separately built/tested exact formatted current executable; same bytes on both hosts.
producer.physical_paths: one common source/target path for both builds
producer.toolchain: Same original stock Rust 1.99 compiler and native tools. The observed Git upgrade is separately bound through unchanged actual build-script fields.

profiler_prerequisite.allowed_prospective_tool_change: None in this study. Reuse only the already qualified ceiling-only Callgrind core, after fresh guest controls and exact identities.
profiler_prerequisite.original_staged_tools: Private expanded-brk 3.22 runtime; fresh per-host qualification and exact common payload required.
profiler_prerequisite.reason: Reuse the qualified ceiling-only Callgrind core with fresh per-host controls and reject every brk overflow warning.
profiler_prerequisite.required: Fresh readback of all 640 exact profiler files and two aliases on these same hosts, joined to their accepted original guest controls and a new protocol-specific Root receipt.

purpose: A separately registered direct confirmation of the formatted current executable on both original hosts.

registry_cache.baseline: Actual private committed records required before/after every dirty native/profiled command. Record count, bytes and SHA inventory; collision replacements may alter slots.
registry_cache.candidate: Actual private committed records required before/after every dirty native/profiled command. Record count, bytes and SHA inventory; collision replacements may alter slots.
registry_cache.witness_scope: Magic, key-to-slot relation, bounded private regular files and supported JSON shape; no independent keyed-BLAKE3 or hit-count claim.

state_banks: Authenticate each host’s original complete independently warmed per-arm bank and populated 445-slot/803161-byte cache; make independent copies into fresh bank paths. Restore the same canonical active paths, verify unchanged compiler/runtime/source inputs and zero-compiler parent freshness, then acquire new native/profile/context/diagnostic/output references per arm. No cross-host or cross-arm state import.

statistics.estimator: geometric mean of paired candidate/baseline counts
statistics.multiple_testing: Both independent fixed VM blocks must pass separately; no pooled or additive claim.
statistics.sign: two-sided exact sign test, ties excluded in p and disqualifying for the 8/8 gate

workload_edit: Use the exact accepted donor fixture: append a deterministic ordinary non-doc comment, warm its state=before form, then change it to state=after_. The strings have equal length and five changed bytes. All Rust tokens and source positions remain unchanged. Restore the original source afterward; no production uv change.
workload_tools: Published SDK12 f93 Rust/rustdoc and fixed Wild execute uv, distinct from the stock producer compiler. Only Cargo varies.
